entities.summary: Ryan Kinasewich is a Croatian-Canadian former professional ice hockey forward who played most notably in the American Hockey League (AHL), the ECHL, and the Austrian Erste Bank Eishockey Liga (EBEL). As of 2021, he is the head coach the Utah Grizzlies in the ECHL.
